yarn-dinkum.meaning: All rules kept: TDY over 12 hours, Concur authorisation, no salary/schedule limits, travel ends at hotel or home, departure time zone, log items, 26 pay periods, forfeiture on leaving GSA.
yarn-dinkum.sense: "Have a squiz", "if you're after more detail", "got in" for flights arriving all fit; "we reckon it's worth keeping a log" softens a recommendation but keeps the sense.
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Mostly natural, but "there are no limits on earning travel comp time either way" and "The hours go on elapsed time" are a bit off.
yarn-dinkum.register: A light level-2 touch: "Have a squiz", "we reckon", "Got questions?". No swearing.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Keeps the helpful HR-guide tone; "we reckon it's worth keeping a log" is a touch casual for official advice.
yarn-dinkum.flow: Some clunky joins: "is gone too: it's forfeited" repeats itself; "either way" dangles.

dinkum-3.meaning: Everything kept, e.g. "Anyone can earn travel comp time: there are no limits based on salary level or schedule type." and "any travel comp time you haven't used is forfeited too."
dinkum-3.sense: "put in for", "have a squiz", "Give your Timekeeper or an HR Specialist at your agency a shout", "took off and landed" all fit.
dinkum-3.authenticity: Sounds natural throughout: "If you've been approved to travel for work and the travel happens outside regular working hours, you can put in for travel comp time."
dinkum-3.register: Exactly level 2: plain guidance with "put in for", "have a squiz", "a shout". No swearing.
dinkum-3.tone: Helpful and businesslike, as the original.
dinkum-3.flow: Reads as if written that way.

dinkum-4.meaning: Everything kept; "There's no cap on earning travel comp time based on your salary level or schedule type."
dinkum-4.sense: "no cap", "Have a squiz", "sing out to your Timekeeper" all fit.
dinkum-4.authenticity: Natural: "If you've got questions, sing out to your Timekeeper or an HR Specialist at your agency."; "the time zone where you left from" is slightly off.
dinkum-4.register: Light level 2 touch, close to the original wording elsewhere. No swearing.
dinkum-4.flow: Mostly smooth; "Use the time zone where you left from to work out the elapsed time." is a little clumsy.

yarn-dinkum.quote: any travel comp time you haven't used is gone too: it's forfeited.
yarn-dinkum.original: any unused travel comp time will be forfeited.

yarn-dinkum.quote: there are no limits on earning travel comp time either way.
yarn-dinkum.original: There are no limitations for earning travel comp time based on salary level or schedule type.
yarn-dinkum.why: Either way dangles after the reordered sentence.

yarn-dinkum.quote: To get your travel time right, we reckon it's worth keeping a log of:
yarn-dinkum.original: To accurately report travel time, we recommend keeping a log of:

dinkum-4.quote: Use the time zone where you left from to work out the elapsed time.
dinkum-4.original: Use the time zone at departure to calculate elapsed time.
dinkum-4.why: Where ... from is a clumsy double preposition.

summaries.yarn-dinkum: Accurate and light, with a few slack joins.
summaries.dinkum-3: Clean, natural and exactly on brief.
summaries.dinkum-4: Accurate and natural, a hair behind B.
